Subject: Pilot Proposal: Invoice Handling Assessment

Hi Morgan,

I am writing to propose our pilot to assess invoice handling. 

This six-week pilot will assess your invoice handling as you aim for your target of 20% shorter handling time. Please note that no baseline or measured savings exists at this stage, and a production rollout is excluded from this scope. The pilot is structured at a $30,000 fixed fee.

Regarding our next steps, security approval is required before access to client data, and no start date has been approved yet. 

To move this initiative forward, please approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance. 

Best regards,

Jordan
Engagement Lead
